item.description:

item.title: Examining circuit boards from the Space Shuttle's I/O Processor
item.description:
📝 Two pages from the Space Shuttle I/O Processor: the "MIA" interface page and the PROM page. The page holds two printed-circuit boards, one on each side of the page. Each board implements two network interfaces, so the page supports four networks.
🔗 Read more: https://www.righto.com/2026/06/space-shuttle-io-processor-boards.html

item.title: Historical memory prices 1960-2026
item.description:
📝 $/GB is the cheapest listed retail price in nominal USD — not contract, average, inflation-adjusted, or a confirmed sale price. DRAM history is the McCallum dataset (extended from mid-2024 by Keepa Amazon prices); NAND is Keepa's cheapest consumer-NVMe price from 2016 (approximate anchors before); HBM figures are modeled estimates. Mid-2024 onward: the cheapest new consumer DIMM each month from Keepa (Amazon retail price history), refreshed monthly.
🔗 Read more: https://dam.stanford.edu/memory-prices.html
